          open={open}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          title="Delete Workspace?"
          description="This action cannot be undone. All database records and configs will be deleted."
          confirmLabel="Delete Workspace"
          tone="danger"
          loading={loading}
          onConfirm={() => {

            setTimeout(() => {
              setLoading(false);
              setOpen(false);
            }, 1000);
          }}
        />
